claims.quote: In normal hearts, Shp2 controls cardiomyocyte size by regulating signaling through protein kinase B (Akt) and mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR).
If rapamycin was started at 6 wk of age, HCM was also ameliorated.
Importantly, rapamycin treatment started shortly after birth rescued the Q510E-Shp2-induced phenotype in vivo.
In summary, our studies establish a role for mTOR signaling in HCM caused by Q510E-Shp2.
